UI_PZMM_app_changed: PZMM changed your mods since you opened this screen.
UI_PZMM_bisect_found: Found it: %1 causes the problem. Your mod list is restored.
UI_PZMM_bisect_found_group: It's in this group: %1. These mods need each other, so they were tested together: turn off the ones nothing else needs, one at a time, to find which. Your mod list is restored.
UI_PZMM_bisect_needs_two: Enable at least two mods to search for a broken one.
UI_PZMM_bisect_none: The problem still happens with every suspect off, so it isn't one of these mods. Your mod list is restored.
UI_PZMM_bisect_one_group: Your enabled mods all need each other (%1), so the search can't split them into groups to test: turn some off by hand to narrow it down.
UI_PZMM_bisect_together: %1 breaks it only together with mods in another group: turning it off fixes your list, but it's fine on its own. Your mod list is restored.

UI_PZMM_notice_feed: change notes and their history, and loading the notes for more mods.
UI_PZMM_notice_home: Featured from The Indie Stone and its news, the Workshop picture on each update, starting a hosted server, and its Stopped, Starting and Crashed states.
UI_PZMM_notice_java: setting up, repairing or removing ZombieBuddy, scanning inside each jar, checking each jar's signature, approving Java mods, setting up Project Viewpoint, other Java loaders and copying a jar's SHA-256.
UI_PZMM_notice_make: checking any mod folder and building its upload folder.
UI_PZMM_notice_maps: installing a map's missing requirements, a mod ID in two items, a background picture, the Workshop maps source in the list (Map-tagged items you haven't installed, with its scan and Stop, an Install on those rows and in Compare), searching maps by tag, checking Workshop maps you haven't installed and subscriber counts (Steam's details don't give them).
UI_PZMM_notice_mods3: installing from a zip, folder, GitHub or a link, the game's error log, removing unused server profiles and setting up Project Viewpoint, reinstall, subscriber count, Mod ID matches and listed by the author in details, trusting files at launch and the desktop-only Check setup fixes (switch build, find a B42 version, verify game files, remove the extra copy, unsubscribe the others, get the original, update the game).
UI_PZMM_notice_saves: backup screenshots, managing backups (delete, rename, named slots), automatic backups, Copy as and Copy with my mods (the game can't copy folders), repairing empty map files, characters' positions and data, the sandbox editor, the Data tab, deleted saves and listing other broken files.
UI_PZMM_notice_servers2: running a dedicated server (setup, console, players, backups and files), hosting beyond start, stop and restart (a warned restart with abort, updating, adopting or finding an existing server, checking the Workshop for external servers, copying diagnostics), hosting tabs (automation with crash and scheduled restarts, warnings, backups every N and the Discord bot and relay; world tools to copy a world, reset chunks or migrate; a mods editor that adds from a collection, profile or preset, autosorts and checks conflicts; the ini settings editor with presets), remote servers (RCON, FTP and the Files tab), the public join address, the country filter and its setting, listing servers without Steam (a Steam Web API key), your Steam friends' servers, a server's player list, restoring a past join's setup and, in the join dialog, map overlap and maps-not-in-mods warnings, per-mod size and updated date, server keywords, a caution for a very recent update and Remember password (the game can't ask a server who is online).
UI_PZMM_notice_settings2: folders (editing), accounts and keys, Performance (memory, JVM arguments, PZOpt, the largest mods), language (the game's is used), launch options and a profile's own game folder, the server-country setting, which page the Workshop opens on and results per page, and re-downloading the mods PZMM installed.
UI_PZMM_notice_workshop2: browsing the Workshop with filters, tags, sorting and pages, an item's stars, comments and pictures, making a profile from a collection, the mods-by-this-author and mods-that-need drill-downs, the item's change-notes tab, Collections with this item (that needs Workshop queries), its description, subscriber, visitor and favourite counts and tags, and the Workshop's Home view (popular this week, most subscribed, newest, recently updated, most required).
UI_PZMM_order_drag_hint: Drag to reorder. Enter or double-click opens a mod.
UI_PZMM_order_lede: Mods load top to bottom. When two change the same file, the lower one wins. The library is yours to organise: its order doesn't change this one.
